windowTitle: Serial integration stage 5/6 - default OPL App end-to-end deploy, readiness, access and event inside Serve's own store
scope: Extend the default-OPL-App proof from first-delivery admission (Reserve) to the full Serve-side delivery: Deploy through the real runtime adapter to a confirmed ready runtime, the committed active deployment and access entry, and the runtime-availability Outbox fact. No production source, contract, schema, migration or generator changed; this is a focused isolated-PostgreSQL test on the current Serve owner store.
implemented: services/serve/internal/delivery/write_postgres_test.go: TestServeDefaultAppDeploysReadyAndPublishesAccess reserves the default OPL App from an approved Runtime Release (no CapabilityVersion/Build/Package), then Deploys it: Serve reaches READY through the runtime adapter, commits application_kind='opl_app' with deployment status 'active', GetWorkspaceAccess returns the confirmed access URL, exactly one serve.agent_readiness_observed.v1 event is emitted, and the applied model configuration version stays 0 (never fabricated from the requested version).

resourcesForServe in the same test file now echoes the requested resource-set workspace and data-attachment id (defaults unchanged for existing tests), so the default App's own workspace identity is exercised.

verification.environment: local loopback PostgreSQL container for the owner-migration tests
cases: TestServeDefaultAppDeploysReadyAndPublishesAccess: default App Deploy -> READY, deployment active, kind opl_app, access URL confirmed, one readiness event, applied model version 0.
TestServeDefaultAppReservationCarriesNoCapabilityVersion still passes; all existing Serve delivery and migration suites pass.

notRun: No real Runtime Control, TKE cluster, Candidate build, Instance deployment or production readback.
The default App's real route activation (I07 RouteProvider) and the publisher opl-model-config/v1 applied readback (I08 serving half) remain open on their frozen external contracts.
The Console/BFF-to-Serve default-App business chain (I11) is not exercised here.
claimBoundary: This receipt claims a Cloud source-level proof with a focused isolated-PostgreSQL test: the default OPL App is deployable end to end inside Serve's own owner store with no Build/Package/CapabilityVersion, reaching a committed ready deployment and access entry. It does not claim real route activation, publisher model-config readback, a Candidate, deployment or production acceptance.
